pitFirewall: No current holiday calendar is backfilled to historical dates for the promoted states.
No future trading date is needed to compute WEEKDAY or MONTH_OF_YEAR.
The promotion does not cover holiday/pre-holiday/post-holiday/turn-of-month/lunar/rebalance states.
No return outcome, alpha sign, trading threshold or score is opened at L3.
Any later calendar-return study must preregister hypotheses and apply multiple-testing controls.
falsification: Replayable calendar-state data does not prove a calendar anomaly exists.
Published Taiwan calendar effects can decay, reverse or depend on market structure and sample period.
Testing many weekdays/months/windows creates severe false-discovery risk.
A bounded TWSE 2017 feasibility receipt is not full-Taiwan, multi-decade or TPEx coverage.

maturityDecision.reason: Existing executable official historical TWSE calendar logic plus physically verified 2017 official-session coverage makes weekday/month-of-year state replay deterministic and PIT-safe within the bounded scope; outcomes remain closed.

exactNext: Append at least one additional independent historical year before any robustness inference.
Seek historical calendar-vintage/announcedAt evidence before adding holiday/pre-holiday/post-holiday or turn-of-month states.
Keep lunar/settlement/rebalance subfamilies separately preregistered and source-gated.
No L4 until prospective/OOS cost-adjusted multiple-testing-controlled outcome evidence exists.
